remarks: Highest and Best by Tuesday, June 2nd at 12pm. Lovingly maintained and thoughtfully updated and rare property in a peaceful neighborhood setting. The main home features 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, an eat-in kitchen, dining room, and mudroom for easy everyday living. The lower-level accessory apartment has its own private entrance and includes a bedroom, full bath, eat-in kitchen, living room, and separate washer/dryer. Currently producing $2,200/month in rental income, the space is ideal for buyers looking to offset expenses, create long-term income potential, or accommodate multigenerational living.
